assumptions.choice: Computed a 120-bar least-squares linear-regression value projected to the most recent bar.
assumptions.reason: The specification names a Linear Regression moving average but does not define its calculation formula.

assumptions.choice: Used population standard deviation over the 120 closing prices.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives the period but does not specify sample versus population standard deviation.

assumptions.choice: Implemented the provided short-entry and short-exit rules.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly supplies short rules as a completeness addition.

assumptions.choice: Used native fixed Stop and StopTrail orders linked as OCO protective exits.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires both a 5% fixed stop-loss and a 1% trailing stop-loss without defining their interaction; OCO ensures either protective exit closes the trade once.
